angles.name: One of a kind
angles.hook: Nobody else's keys carry these scales.
angles.primary_short: Nobody else's keys carry these scales. Our Nile crocodile leather key ring, €25, brings natural texture to the keys you carry every day. Duties & taxes included.
angles.primary_long: Every crocodile hide carries its own pattern, so every loop we cut from it is one of a kind. Our key ring pairs a loop of Nile crocodile leather with a metal ring, cut from the same South African hides as our belts and cases. Genuine and CITES certified, shipped from the EU with duties & taxes included. A small piece of something singular, carried every day. Choose black, brown or cognac, €25.
angles.headline: A scale pattern only you carry. €25

angles.name: Origin: the Sabie River farm
angles.hook: The same river-farm leather as our belts, on your keys.
angles.primary_short: The same river-farm leather as our belts, on your keys. A Nile crocodile leather key ring for the keys you carry daily, €25. CITES certified, duties & taxes included.
angles.primary_long: Our farm was founded in 1997 on the banks of the Sabie River in Hazyview, Mpumalanga, South Africa. The same hides that become our belts and cases are cut into this key ring: a loop of Nile crocodile leather on a metal ring. Seronera gives back to South African communities, supporting education initiatives and orphanages. Shipped from the EU, duties & taxes included. Start the collection with the keys you carry each day, €25.
angles.headline: From the Sabie River to your keys

angles.name: Everyday styling
angles.hook: You reach for your keys a dozen times a day.
angles.primary_short: You reach for your keys a dozen times a day. Give them a key ring of Nile crocodile leather, in black, brown or cognac. €25, duties & taxes included.
angles.primary_long: On the way out, on the hall table, on the desk beside you: your keys go everywhere you do. This key ring pairs a loop of Nile crocodile leather with a metal ring, cut from the same hides as our belts and cases, so it sits naturally alongside them. Choose black, brown or cognac to match what you already wear. Quiet, tactile and entirely yours, as no two scale patterns are alike. Shipped from the EU with duties & taxes included. €25.
